00044 PlugUGenInternal::PlugUGenInternal(UGen const& source, bool shouldAllowAutoDelete) throw()
00045 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(0, source.getNumChannels() - 1),
00046     currentSourceIndex(-1),
00047     fadeSourceIndex(-1),
00048     shouldAllowAutoDelete_(shouldAllowAutoDelete)
00049 {   
00050     setSource(source, true);
00051 }

00053 void PlugUGenInternal::prepareForBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID) throw()
00054 {
00055     const int size = sources.size();
00056     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00057     {
00058         sources[i].prepareForBlock(actualBlockSize, blockID);
00059     }
00060 }

00072 void PlugUGenInternal::stealInternal() throw()

00082 void PlugUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00083 {
00084     bool shouldDeleteLocal;
00085     bool& shouldDeleteToPass = shouldAllowAutoDelete_ ? shouldDelete : shouldDeleteLocal;   
00086     
00087     const int numSources = sources.size();
00088     for(int sourceIndex = 0; sourceIndex < numSources; sourceIndex++)
00089     {       
00090         if(currentSourceIndex == sourceIndex)
00091         {
00092             if(fadeSourceIndex != -1)
00093             {
00094                 float fadeSourceFadeLevel, currentSourceFadeLevel;
00095                 const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00096                 
00097                 for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00098                 {
00099                     shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00100                     int numSamples = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00101                     float *currentSourceSamples = sources[currentSourceIndex].processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00102                     float *fadeSourceSamples = sources[fadeSourceIndex].processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00103                     float *outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00104                     fadeSourceFadeLevel = this->fadeSourceFadeLevel;  // need local copies because we mave multiple channels
00105                     currentSourceFadeLevel = this->currentSourceFadeLevel;
00106                     
00107                     while(numSamples--)
00108                     {
00109                         *outputSamples++ =  (*currentSourceSamples++ * currentSourceFadeLevel) +
00110                                             (*fadeSourceSamples++ * fadeSourceFadeLevel);
00111                         
00112                         currentSourceFadeLevel += deltaFade;
00113                         fadeSourceFadeLevel -= deltaFade;
00114                         
00115                         if(fadeSourceFadeLevel <= 0.f)
00116                         {
00117                             fadeSourceFadeLevel = 0.f;
00118                             currentSourceFadeLevel = 1.f;
00119                         }
00120                     }
00121                 }
00122                 
00123                 if(fadeSourceFadeLevel <= 0.f)
00124                 {
00125                     fadeSourceIndex = -1;
00126                     if(releasePreviousSourcesAfterFade)
00127                     {
00128                         sources = tempSource;
00129                         currentSourceIndex = 0;
00130                     }
00131                 }
00132                 else
00133                 {
00134                     this->fadeSourceFadeLevel = fadeSourceFadeLevel;
00135                     this->currentSourceFadeLevel = currentSourceFadeLevel;
00136                 }
00137             }
00138             else
00139             {
00140                 const int memcpySize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize() * sizeof(float);
00141                 const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00142                 
00143                 for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00144                 {
00145                     shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00146                     float *sourceSamples = sources[currentSourceIndex].processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00147                     float *outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00148                     
00149                     memcpy(outputSamples, sourceSamples, memcpySize);
00150                 }
00151             }
00152         }
00153         else
00154         {
00155             shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00156             sources[sourceIndex].processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, -1); // process previous sources
00157         }
00158     }   
00159     
00160 }

00162 void PlugUGenInternal::setSource(UGen const& source, const bool releasePreviousSources, const float fadeTime)
00163 {
00164     if(releasePreviousSources == true && fadeTime <= 0.f)
00165     {
00166         fadeSourceIndex = -1;
00167         sources = UGenArray(source);
00168         currentSourceIndex = 0;
00169     }
00170     else
00171     {       
00172         int indexOfExistingSource = sources.indexOf(source);
00173                 
00174         if(currentSourceIndex != -1 && fadeTime > 0.f)
00175         {
00176             fadeSourceIndex = currentSourceIndex;
00177             fadeSourceFadeLevel = 1.f;
00178             currentSourceFadeLevel = 0.f;
00179             deltaFade = (float)UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() / fadeTime;
00180         }
00181         else
00182             fadeSourceIndex = -1;
00183         
00184         if(indexOfExistingSource == -1)
00185         {
00186             sources = UGenArray(sources, source, false);
00187             currentSourceIndex++;
00188         }
00189         else
00190             currentSourceIndex = indexOfExistingSource;
00191         
00192         releasePreviousSourcesAfterFade = releasePreviousSources;
00193         if(releasePreviousSourcesAfterFade == true && fadeTime > 0.f)
00194             tempSource = UGenArray(source);
00195     }
00196 }
00197 
00198 UGen& PlugUGenInternal::getSource()
00199 {
00200     return sources[currentSourceIndex];
00201 }
